title: Number of Subsequences That Satisfy the Given Sum Condition
problemStatement: Given an integer array and an integer Target, count the number of non-empty subsequences such that the sum of the minimum and maximum element in the subsequence is less than or equal to Target.
input: • First line contains integers N and Target. • Second line contains N integers.
output: Print the number of valid subsequences modulo 10^9 + 7.
